# License texts absent from the published packages

The production notice builder reads these copies for the exact releases
named by their filenames. The installed packages or the Worker's source
map identify the versions.

| File prefix              | License source                                                                                                                |
| ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `change-case`            | [change-case 5.4.4](https://github.com/blakeembrey/change-case/blob/change-case%405.4.4/LICENSE)                              |
| `map-obj`                | [map-obj 5.0.2 npm tarball](https://registry.npmjs.org/map-obj/-/map-obj-5.0.2.tgz), `package/license`                        |
| `react-dnd-invariant`    | [The upstream invariant implementation](https://github.com/zertosh/invariant/blob/master/LICENSE)                             |
| `react-dnd-shallowequal` | [The upstream shallowequal implementation](https://github.com/dashed/shallowequal/blob/master/LICENSE)                        |
| `react-three-fiber`      | [React Three Fiber 9.8.2](https://github.com/pmndrs/react-three-fiber/blob/v9.8.2/LICENSE)                                    |
| `snakecase-keys`         | [snakecase-keys 9.0.2 npm tarball](https://registry.npmjs.org/snakecase-keys/-/snakecase-keys-9.0.2.tgz), `package/license`   |
| `standardwebhooks`       | [The Standard Webhooks libraries license](https://github.com/standard-webhooks/standard-webhooks/blob/main/libraries/LICENSE) |

The build also carries the [Eclipse Public License 1.0](https://spdx.org/licenses/EPL-1.0.html)
for the EMF 2.12.4 sources in elkjs and the [shadcn/ui registry license](https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/LICENSE.md)
for the registry code in `apps/game/src/components/ui/` and `apps/game/src/lib/utils.ts`.
